answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose an extension to the current table-to-text task, where besides tables, associated images are also useful to generate meaningful and complete sentences ...
answer_1.outputs: natural language description sentences (≈35 tokens) per landmark

answer_2.quote: We report TEOR, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L, and BLEURT for evaluating the performance of text generation ...

answer_4.quote: To better understand the effect of using visual information in VISTOT, we conduct a human evaluation of the results obtained by VT3 and VT3 (w/o vision). The annotators were tasked to evaluate the generated sentences on the following metrics: (i) Fluency ... (ii) Faithfulness ...
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators (three human raters) scored each sentence on Fluency and Faithfulness using a 3‑point Likert scale (0, 1, 2).
